anchors.text: Customer Intake is followed by Identity Check before Account Activation.
Account Activation is owned by Customer Operations.
Raw Archive retains approved records for 30 days before Curated Archive.
Curated Archive sends expired records to Verified Deletion.
Build Steward owns the signed package.
Release Manager approves the signed package before Production Gateway.
Payment Intake goes to Risk Screening. A flagged payment goes to Analyst Review; an unflagged payment goes to Settlement Queue.
Vendor Sponsor submits the access request to Security Validation.
Approved vendor access expires after 14 days.
Identity Check hands verified customers to Account Activation.
Service Owner escalates unresolved incidents to Incident Commander.
Incident Commander assigns Communications Lead.
Invoice Match routes mismatches to Finance Investigation before Supplier Query.
Requester and Reviewer are the two existing process roles.
Draft, Review and Publish are the existing approval sequence labels.
Queued, Running and Complete are the existing status labels.
Sensor Intake goes to Calibration Check. If Reading valid? is Yes, Publish Telemetry then Operations Dashboard. If No, Quarantine Sample then Lab Review.
Field Technician attaches Site Photo. If Safety cleared? is Yes, Close Visit. If No, Dispatch Supervisor then Arrange Return.
Price Analyst submits Version 2 to Commercial Approver before Catalog Publish.
Policy Owner approves exception EX-903 before Compliance Register records it.
Legal Reviewer and Procurement Lead must approve Change Set B before Supplier Notice.
During Vector Search Unavailable, material-backed drawing is blocked while Manual Drawing remains available.
Retry Retrieval may continue only after Vector Search is restored.
Canvas Save Failed must preserve the current canvas and offer Retry Save.
A repeated save failure is escalated to Storage Support.
OCR Unavailable blocks source-grounded extraction and offers Retry OCR.
After a completed OCR failure, the user may provide a manual source excerpt.
Evidence Blob Unavailable blocks cited material generation until Blob Read is restored.
The recovery event is recorded in Retrieval Audit.
